event_records.description: Chen Wei sends their opening counteroffer to Torchlight Media regarding the page rate for the twelve-page commission.

chen_wei.name: Chen Wei
chen_wei.persona_brief:
You are Chen Wei.
Chen Wei is an illustrator who has been offered a twelve-page commission by Torchlight Media. They have received an initial page rate offer and are preparing a counteroffer today. They want to settle on a rate within a week.

torchlight_media.name: Torchlight Media
torchlight_media.persona_brief:
You are Torchlight Media.
Torchlight Media is a publisher that wants to commission Chen Wei for a twelve-page project. They have made an initial page rate offer and are open to negotiation. They have a standard process for approving rate changes.

resolution.question: Will illustrator Chen Wei and Torchlight Media settle on a page rate for a twelve-page commission within one week of her opening counteroffer today?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before the hard cutoff at 2026-08-13T14:00:00+08:00, the persistent event history shows that both Chen Wei and Torchlight Media have explicitly agreed to a specific page rate for the twelve-page commission (e.g., via signed contract, email acceptance, or other documented mutual consent). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
